target.definition: adjusted close 5 trading sessions after the as-of date is higher than the adjusted close on the as-of date

snapshot_limits: Universe fixed as of end-2021: no hindsight inside a 2022+ holdout, but companies delisted or acquired since are missing (Yahoo serves current tickers only).
Before 2022 the list is hindsight-chosen (large in 2021): development results are flattered by survivorship bias.
Yahoo does not adjust prices for every spin-off (e.g. GE's); such days appear as large one-day falls.
Sector ETFs XLC (2018) and XLRE (2015) are young: their stocks have no sector features before then.
FRED yields are as published now, after revisions; Treasury yields are rarely revised.

splits.purge: training rows must have their 5-session label window end more than 5 sessions before the test period starts

selection.label: Random forest
selection.criterion: lowest pooled walk-forward validation Brier score among models

leakage_checks.check: model inputs are schema features only
leakage_checks.detail: every input column is defined in the feature schema

leakage_checks.check: no feature is implausibly correlated with the future return
leakage_checks.detail: largest absolute rank correlations: spy_ret_5 0.053, ret_5 0.050, qqq_ret_5 0.050 (limit 0.2)

leakage_checks.check: training label windows end before every test period
leakage_checks.detail: 9 splits checked; smallest gap between the last training label and the first test date is 6 sessions (must exceed 5)

leakage_checks.check: sampled rows are reproducible from past bars alone
leakage_checks.detail: 12 rows recomputed with every later bar removed; largest relative feature difference 0.00e+00, largest label difference 0.00e+00

leakage_checks.check: a model trained on shuffled labels cannot predict
leakage_checks.detail: validation ROC-AUC over 5 shuffles of the training labels: 0.4887, 0.5065, 0.4867, 0.4981, 0.4961; mean 0.4952 (must be within 0.020 of 0.5)

table.scaling: forward return divided by (21-session standard deviation of daily returns x sqrt(horizon))

holdout_evaluation.rule: the volatility-scaled range is used only if its pinball loss is lower than the unscaled range's and its 80% range covers between 75% and 85% of outcomes

expected_return.served_as: historical mean of development data (no model beat it)
expected_return.rule: a model's expected return is served only if its R-squared against the historical mean is above 0 in validation and its 95% holdout interval is above 0

limitations: Skill in forecasting direction is not profit. Costs, the size of moves and position sizing are not part of these scores.
Rows are correlated across stocks and overlap in time; intervals resample calendar weeks to allow for this, which is an approximation.
The model was fitted through the end of the development period and has not been refitted on later data.

calibration_bands.rule: a band is miscalibrated when observed and stated rates differ by more than 0.03 and the 95% interval of the gap excludes zero

rule: The candidate is the one model chosen on development data (lowest pooled validation Brier score). Only it can be promoted.
Holdout Brier skill against the constant-base-rate baseline is above 0, and the lower end of its 95% calendar-week bootstrap interval is above 0.
The lower end of the 95% interval for holdout ROC-AUC is above 0.50.
Brier skill is above 0 in at least two thirds of the holdout calendar years that have 1000 or more rows.
Pooled validation Brier skill (development data) is above 0 as well.
On the holdout, no fifth of the stated probabilities is off by more than 0.03 with a 95% interval that excludes zero.

requirements.requirement: candidate is a model, not a baseline
holdout Brier skill > 0 with 95% interval above 0
positive skill in at least two thirds of holdout years
no miscalibrated probability band on the holdout

promotion.verdict: not promoted: no predictive edge established under the pre-written rule
